_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: growth inside an already-paired pair leaves the guard green (buggy counting)
expectedRed.why: On correct code growth inside an already-paired pair is counted and fails the guard, so the assertion that the guard stays green fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the (buggy) counting that ignores intra-pair growth is back.
